summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Epic E10 Product Export/Import feature. All backend API endpoints (export CSV/XLSX, template download, analyze, validate, commit) are working correctly (9/9 tests passed). Frontend UI testing verified the complete import/export workflow including admin login, export buttons, import wizard with smart column mapping, editable preview with error detection, and successful product creation. Tested with intentionally invalid CSV data (2 invalid rows out of 5) and confirmed proper validation and error handling.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/admin/products/io/export?format=csv returns 200 with CSV content
Backend: GET /api/admin/products/io/export?format=xlsx returns 200 with XLSX content
Backend: GET /api/admin/products/io/template?format=csv returns 200
Backend: GET /api/admin/products/io/template?format=xlsx returns 200
Backend: POST /api/admin/products/io/analyze returns 200 with correct structure (headers, rows, suggested_mapping)
Backend: POST /api/admin/products/io/validate returns 200 with products, reports, summary
Backend: POST /api/admin/products/io/commit (add-only mode) returns 200 with created/updated counts
Backend: RBAC - Export requires admin role (403 for customer, 401 for unauthenticated)
Backend: RBAC - Unauthenticated access to export returns 401
Frontend: Admin login flow at /admin with admin@collectorparfum.id
Frontend: Products page loads with Export and Import buttons visible
Frontend: Export dropdown menu opens showing 'Ekspor CSV' and 'Ekspor Excel (.xlsx)' options
Frontend: Export CSV triggers download (produk_export_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.csv)
Frontend: Export XLSX triggers download (produk_export_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.xlsx)
Frontend: Import button navigates to /admin/produk/impor
Frontend: Import page shows dropzone and template download buttons
Frontend: Template CSV download works (template_impor_produk.csv)
Frontend: Template XLSX download works (template_impor_produk.xlsx)
Frontend: File upload via hidden file input works correctly
Frontend: Smart column mapping auto-fills after file upload (Nama Produk->name, Kategori->category, etc.)
Frontend: Summary chips show correct validation results (5 baris, 3 valid, 2 error, 2 produk)
Frontend: Preview table displays all 5 rows with editable inputs
Frontend: Error indicators ('1 isu') appear on invalid rows (row 4: empty name, row 5: unknown category)
Frontend: 'Hanya error' filter toggles to show only error rows
Frontend: Mode selection shows 'Tambah saja' (add-only) and 'Upsert' options
Frontend: Commit button shows 'Impor 2 Produk' (only valid products)
Frontend: Commit triggers POST /api/admin/products/io/commit and shows result dialog
Frontend: Result dialog shows created=2, updated=0 (2 valid products created, 2 invalid skipped)
Frontend: Imported products appear in /admin/produk list when searching 'uji qa'
Frontend: Sidebar navigation shows 'Impor / Ekspor' menu item
